title: KARL MAYER - LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
KARL MAYER is a mechanical engineering company that offers a wide range of products and services of its sector with the focus on textile machinery building. The business activities are concentrated on the fields of warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation for weaving. KARL MAYER supports the success of its international customers with products and services that are outstanding in both economic and technical terms, as well as with innovations that move the textile world forward. KARL MAYER has employees all over the world. Thanks to its global organization and its claim to produce in its main markets, the company is always close to its customers and their needs. Today, it has subsidiaries in the USA, India, Italy, Hong Kong, Japan, China, Turkey, India and Switzerland, as well as agencies in all parts of the world. KARL MAYER is a German family-owned company, which has focused on financial independence and economic sustainability since its foundation in 1937. As a permanent, reliable partner with decades of experience and a high level of quality in all areas, it supports the competitiveness of its customers and business partners. title: Celebrating Georg+Otto Friedrich — KARL MAYER's First Warp ...
content: + The Association of Italian Textile Machinery Manufacturers (ACIMIT). Some of them have been in existence since the very beginning, and one of them recently celebrated a round anniversary: the first warp knitting machine produced by the innovative textile machine manufacturer based in Obertshausen was sent on 10 September 1948 to Georg+Otto Friedrich, a leading producer of warp-knitted digital printing fabrics and technical textiles in the neighboring town of Groß-Zimmern. Today, Georg+Otto Friedrich is the largest customer of the model of KARL MAYER’s most modern generation of tricot machines, the HKS 3-M ON. Thanks to the high technical level of the machines and the know-how of the employees, the textile products made by Georg+Otto Friedrich are of the highest quality. “As the leading manufacturer of textile solutions in Europe and as the world market leader in the field of digitally printable warp-knitted polyester fabrics, we have a special responsibility for environmental and social issues,” explained Philipp Seubert, managing director of GOF Industrial.
